title: Jamul Drive-Through Distribution
description: The Jamul distribution serves local households through a convenient drive-through pickup where volunteers load food boxes directly into cars.
points: Designed for dignity, convenience, and care
Supports families and neighbors in the Jamul area
Contact us for current pickup details and sign-up information

title: Santee Senior Pantry
description: The Santee Senior Pantry gives older adults a welcoming way to choose nutritious groceries and receive support that fits their needs.
points: Serves seniors in a friendly "grocery store" setting
Allows participants to choose preferred grocery items
Delivery support available for housebound seniors

title: La Mesa Veterans' Club Emergency Pantry
description: The emergency pantry provides a local point of support for neighbors who need food assistance outside of regular distribution days.
points: Located at the La Mesa Veterans' Club
Designed for urgent or short-term food needs
Built around dignity, flexibility, and compassion

title: La Mesa Distribution Center
description: The La Mesa distribution center helps serve a large and diverse community through drive-through pickup and delivery support.
points: Helps families access food on their way home from work or school
Welcomes proxy pickups for neighbors, relatives, or families in need
Supports delivery for homebound seniors and vulnerable residents when available
